name: dsh-assist (Preview)
description: Community preview for DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3: reusable personas, scoped memory, and opt-in idle chat that resumes for saved sessions after restart. Windows TGZ installation/loading is verified; real-model proactive-chat end-to-end behavior is not yet verified.
descriptionZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 的社区预发布插件：可复用人设、角色与会话记忆、明确开启后可在重启加载原会话时恢复的主动聊天，默认角色是爱吃白饭的大肥鱼女儿。Windows TGZ 安装与加载已验证；真实模型主动聊天端到端尚未验证。
